name: WIWO Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top championship during its 1999 revival, contested on the road to the promotion's own first pay-per-view.

name: WIWO United States Championship
epitaph: The promotion's secondary singles championship during its 1999 revival.

name: WIWO Television Championship
epitaph: A championship left vacant during the promotion's 1999 revival after a televised title match ran out of time before a fall.

name: WIWO Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The promotion's tag team championship during its 1999 revival.
